records.literal_gloss: Sing to YHWH a new song; sing to YHWH, all the earth.

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a new song; \q sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth.
en.B: Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q All the earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Everyone on earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un cantique nouveau ; \q chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, toute la terre.
fr.B: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau ! \q Terre entière, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Chantez un chant nouveau {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Vous tous qui vivez sur la terre, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya; \q mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia yote.
sw.B: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya! \q Dunia yote, mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya! \q Kila mtu duniani, mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un cántico nuevo; \q {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un cántico nuevo! \q ¡Toda la tierra, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una canción nueva! \q ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một bài ca mới; \q hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi cả trái đất.
vi.B: Hãy hát một bài ca mới cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hỡi cả trái đất, hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Hãy hát một bài ca mới cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래로 노래하여라. \q 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를 불러라! \q 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 새 노래를 불러라! \q 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라!

pt.L: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um cântico novo; \q cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra.
pt.B: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um cântico novo! \q Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra!
pt.R: Cantem uma canção nova {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! \q Todos na terra, cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}!

am.L: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ፤ \q ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ።
am.B: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ! \q ምድር ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ!
am.R: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አዲስ መዝሙር ዘምሩ! \q በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए नया गीत गाओ; \q हे सारी पृथ्वी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए एक नया गीत गाओ! \q हे सारी पृथ्वी के लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ!
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए एक नया गीत गाओ! \q पृथ्वी के सब लोगो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ!

ru.L: Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} новую песнь; \q пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вся земля.
ru.B: Пойте новую песнь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! \q Вся земля, пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}!
ru.R: Пойте новую песню {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! \q Все люди на земле, пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}!

ja.L: 新しい歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え。 \q 全地よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え。
ja.B: 新しい歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え！ \q 全地よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え！
ja.R: 新しい歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え！ \q 地上のすべての人々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌え！

uk.L: Співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню; \q співай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, уся земле.
uk.B: Заспівайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню! \q Уся земле, співай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}!
uk.R: Заспівайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} нову пісню! \q Усі на землі, співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}!

decisions.choice: 1 Chronicles 16:23-33
decisions.reason: Most of this psalm (verses 1b-13a) appears, with small differences, in 1 Chronicles 16:23-33, in the song sung when David brought the ark of God to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: a new song: fresh praise for what God has done
decisions.reason: A new song answers a new act of God (33:3; 40:4; 98:1). Isaiah 42:10 calls the ends of the earth to sing one.

decisions.choice: all the earth: everyone on earth
decisions.reason: The whole earth is called on, that is, all its peoples (verses 3, 7, 10), not Israel only.

decisions.choice: "vous" for the hearers called to praise ("Chantez"), for Psalms 84-104
decisions.reason: The psalm calls the whole earth and every people, so French uses the plural imperative, as it does for any group.

decisions.choice: Canten, with Cantad as the alternative
decisions.reason: "All the earth" means all its peoples, so the commands are plural, with the plural you setting: Latin American forms by default, the forms of Spain as the alternative.

decisions.choice: The commands to the earth and the peoples are in 해라체 ("-하여라", "-아")
decisions.reason: The psalm calls all the earth to praise (meaning decision m3); Korean poetry gives such calls in the plain imperative, and God is spoken of with the honorific.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33, line for line, where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Psalm 96 is the song David gave to Asaph in 1 Chronicles 16:23-33, with some lines added or changed. Every line the two share keeps the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 16 at the same level, so the reader meets one song; the Psalm's own lines are new ("um cântico novo" here; verse 2a; "no seu santuário", 6; "entrem nos seus átrios", 8; "Ele julgará os povos", 10; "porque ele vem", 13; and verse 13b).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: the psalm in the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33 on main, level by level, where the Hebrew is the same; this verse adds "a new song" and keeps "ምድር ሁሉ፣ … ዘምሩ" of 16:23
decisions.reason: Psalm 96 and 1 Chronicles 16:23-33 are one song; the Amharic of the Chronicles passage is copied where the Hebrew agrees, and a decision marks each place where the psalm's Hebrew differs.

decisions.choice: the Hindi of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: Most of this psalm is the song of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33 (meaning m1). Where the Hebrew is the same, each level copies the Hindi of Chronicles at that level, so the song reads alike in both books; where the Hebrew differs (here the "new song" and the order of the lines, verses 6, 8, 10 and 13), the wording differs, as noted in those verses. "हे सारी पृथ्वी, ... के लिए गाओ" is 1 Chronicles 16:23 at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33
decisions.reason: Psalm 96 is the song of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33 (m1), drafted first there. Where the Hebrew is the same, each level copies that passage's Russian; where the psalm differs (this line, verses 6, 8, 10 and 13), the wording differs. "Пойте ГОСПОДУ, вся земля" is 1 Chronicles 16:23.

decisions.choice: Psalm 96 copies the Japanese of 1CH 16:23-33 wherever the Hebrew is the same: "全地よ、DNに歌え" (L, B), "地上のすべての人々よ、DNに歌え！" (R) as 1CH 16:23; calls to the earth 〜せよ at every level
decisions.reason: Psalm 96 is the song of 1 Chronicles 16:23-33 (m1); the two are kept word for word where the Hebrew agrees and changed only where it differs. All the earth is everyone on earth (m3); the call to the earth is 〜せよ at R too (1CH, PSA-1 conventions).

decisions.choice: shir chadash "新しい歌"
decisions.reason: A new song is fresh praise for what God has done (m2); the plain words keep the picture.

source.text: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to YHWH, bless his name; bear news from day to day [of] his salvation.

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q bear news from day to day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation.
en.B: Raise your song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; bless {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. \q Day after day announce the good news of how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves.
en.R: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q Tell the good news every day: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves!

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, bénissez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q annoncez de jour en jour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut.
fr.B: Élevez vos chants {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; bénissez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. \q Jour après jour, annoncez la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve.
fr.R: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! \q Chaque jour, dites la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve !

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, libarikini jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q pelekeni habari siku kwa siku za wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Pazeni nyimbo zenu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; libarikini jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Siku baada ya siku tangazeni habari njema za jinsi anavyookoa.
sw.R: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumsifu! \q Elezeni habari njema kila siku: anaokoa!

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} de día en día {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} salvación.
es.B: {{plural_you:Eleven su|Elevad vuestro}} canto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q Día tras día {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} la buena noticia de cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:alábenlo|alabadlo}}! \q {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} la buena noticia cada día: ¡{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva!

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q ngày qua ngày hãy loan tin sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy cất tiếng hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hãy chúc tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngày này qua ngày khác, hãy loan báo tin mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu.
vi.R: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hãy loan báo tin mừng mỗi ngày: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. 그분의 이름을 송축하여라. \q 날마다 그분의 구원을 기쁜 소식으로 전하여라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래를 올려 드리고 그분의 이름을 송축하여라. \q 날마다 그분께서 구원하신다는 기쁜 소식을 전하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하고 그분을 찬양하여라! \q 날마다 기쁜 소식을 전하여라. 그분께서 구원하신다!

pt.L: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, bendigam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q anunciem de dia em dia a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} salvação.
pt.B: Ergam a voz e cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; bendigam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. \q Dia após dia anunciem as boas-novas de como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva.
pt.R: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e deem louvor a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}! \q Anunciem a boa notícia todos os dias: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva!

am.L: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ፤ ስሙን ባርኩ፤ \q ማዳኑን ከቀን ወደ ቀን አብሥሩ።
am.B: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} መዝሙራችሁን አሰሙ፤ ስሙን ባርኩ። \q እንዴት እንደሚያድን ዕለት ዕለት የምሥራቹን አውሩ።
am.R: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘምሩ፤ አመስግኑትም! \q በየቀኑ የምሥራቹን ንገሩ፤ እርሱ ያድናል!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ, उनके नाम को धन्य कहो; \q दिन-प्रतिदिन उनके उद्धार का शुभ समाचार सुनाओ।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए अपना गीत ऊँचा करो; उनके नाम को धन्य कहो। \q दिन पर दिन यह शुभ समाचार सुनाओ कि वे कैसे उद्धार करते हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाओ और उनकी स्तुति करो! \q हर दिन यह शुभ समाचार सुनाओ: वे बचाते हैं!

ru.L: Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, благословляйте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя; \q возвещайте изо дня в день спасение {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Воспойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}; благословляйте {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя. \q День за днём возвещайте радостную весть о том, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спасает.
ru.R: Пойте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и хвалите {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}! \q Каждый день рассказывайте радостную новость: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спасает!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌い、その名をほめたたえよ。 \q 日から日へ、その救いを告げ知らせよ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌をささげ、その名をほめたたえよ。 \q 日ごとに、その方の救いの良い知らせを告げよ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌い、その方をほめたたえよ！ \q 毎日、良い知らせを伝えよ。その方は救ってくださる！

uk.L: Співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, благословляйте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя; \q звіщайте день у день {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} спасіння.
uk.B: Підносьте свою пісню {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}; благословляйте {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя. \q День за днем звіщайте добру новину про те, як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} спасає.
uk.R: Співайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} і хваліть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}! \q Щодня розповідайте добру новину: {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} рятує!

decisions.choice: bless his name: praise God, speak well of him
decisions.reason: To bless (barak) God is to praise him and give him honor; "his name" is God himself as he has made himself known.

decisions.choice: bear news: announce good news
decisions.reason: The verb (basar) is to bring news, usually good news, as in Isaiah 40:9 and 52:7.

decisions.choice: praise him
decisions.reason: Readable says what blessing God's name means (m1).

decisions.choice: "libarikini jina lake" (bless his name) at Literal and Balanced; "kumsifu" (praise him) at Readable
decisions.reason: People bless God by speaking well of him; the terms note keeps "kubariki" for this, and Readable says "praise", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the first line is the psalm's own ("sing to the LORD, bless his name"); the second keeps 1 Chronicles 16:23b ("ማዳኑን ከቀን ወደ ቀን አብሥሩ")
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 16:23 has only "Sing to the LORD, all the earth" before the second line; the added line follows the Hebrew, the shared line copies Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "उनके नाम को धन्य कहो"; "शुभ समाचार सुनाओ"
decisions.reason: To bless God is "धन्य कहना", as the poetry note has it (meaning m1); Readable says "स्तुति करो", as its English says "praise". The second line is 1 Chronicles 16:23b at each level, with "शुभ समाचार" as there, since "सुसमाचार" is kept for the gospel (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: the second line as 1 Chronicles 16:23b
decisions.reason: The second line is the Hebrew of 1 Chronicles 16:23b, so each level keeps that wording.

decisions.choice: barekhu shemo "その名をほめたたえよ" (L, B), "その方をほめたたえよ" (R); the second line word for word 1CH 16:23b
decisions.reason: Bless his name is praise to God (m1), the Psalter's ほめたたえる; bissar is announcing good news (m2), 良い知らせ, not 福音, as in 1 Chronicles 16:23.

records.literal_gloss: Recount among the nations his glory, among all the peoples his wonders.

en.L: Recount among the nations {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q among all the peoples {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders.
en.B: Tell the nations of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q and all the peoples of the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.
en.R: Tell the other nations how great and glorious {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. \q Tell people everywhere about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.

fr.L: Racontez parmi les nations {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q parmi tous les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles.
fr.B: Parlez aux nations de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q et à tous les peuples des merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.
fr.R: Dites aux autres nations combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand et glorieux. \q Dites aux gens de partout les choses extraordinaires qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.

sw.L: Simulieni kati ya mataifa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kati ya watu wote maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Yaelezeni mataifa habari za utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na watu wote habari za maajabu aliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Yaelezeni mataifa mengine jinsi alivyo mkuu na mtukufu. \q Waelezeni watu kila mahali mambo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya.

es.L: {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} entre las naciones {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q entre todos los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} maravillas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} a las naciones de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q y a todos los pueblos de las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cuéntenles|Contadles}} a las otras naciones lo grande y glorioso que es. \q {{plural_you:Cuéntenle|Contadle}} a la gente de todas partes las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

vi.L: Hãy thuật lại giữa các dân tộc vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q giữa mọi dân những việc lạ lùng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy kể cho các dân tộc về vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cho mọi dân về những việc diệu kỳ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Hãy nói cho các dân tộc khác biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại và vinh hiển biết bao. \q Hãy kể cho người ta khắp nơi về những việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 민족들 가운데 그분의 영광을, \q 모든 백성들 가운데 그분의 기적들을 이야기하여라.
ko.B: 민족들에게 그분의 영광을 전하고, \q 모든 백성에게 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 알려라.
ko.R: 다른 민족들에게 그분이 얼마나 크고 영광스러우신지 말하여라. \q 모든 곳의 사람들에게 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 이야기하여라.

pt.L: Contem entre as nações a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, \q entre todos os povos as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas.
pt.B: Falem às nações da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, \q e a todos os povos das maravilhas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.
pt.R: Contem às outras nações como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é grande e glorioso. \q Contem às pessoas de todo lugar as coisas incríveis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.

am.L: ክብሩን በሕዝቦች መካከል ተናገሩ፤ \q ድንቅ ሥራዎቹንም በወገኖች ሁሉ መካከል።
am.B: ክብሩን ለሕዝቦች ንገሩ፤ \q ያደረጋቸውንም ድንቅ ነገሮች ለወገኖች ሁሉ።
am.R: እርሱ ምን ያህል ታላቅና ክቡር እንደ ሆነ ለሌሎች ሕዝቦች ንገሩ። \q ስላደረጋቸው አስደናቂ ነገሮች በየስፍራው ላሉ ሰዎች ንገሩ።

hi.L: जातियों में उनकी महिमा का, \q सब देशों के लोगों में उनके आश्चर्यकर्मों का वर्णन करो।
hi.B: देशों में उनकी महिमा का वर्णन करो, \q और सब लोगों में उनके किए हुए आश्चर्यकर्मों का।
hi.R: दूसरे देशों को बताओ कि वे कितने महान और महिमावान हैं। \q हर जगह के लोगों को उनके किए हुए अद्भुत कामों के बारे में बताओ।

ru.L: Возвещайте среди народов славу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, \q среди всех народов — чудеса {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Расскажите народам о {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славе \q и всем народам — о чудесах, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил.
ru.R: Расскажите другим народам, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} велик и славен. \q Расскажите людям повсюду об удивительных делах, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} совершил.

ja.L: 諸国の民の中にその栄光を、 \q すべての民の中にその奇しいみわざを語り告げよ。
ja.B: その方の栄光を諸国の民に、 \q その方の行われた不思議なみわざをすべての民に語り告げよ。
ja.R: ほかの国々に、その方の偉大さと栄光を伝えよ。 \q その方のしてくださった驚くべきことを、世界中の人々に伝えよ。

uk.L: Розповідайте серед народів про {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} славу, \q серед усіх племен — про {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} чудеса.
uk.B: Розповідайте народам про {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} славу, \q а всім племенам — про дива, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} учинив.
uk.R: Розкажіть іншим народам, який {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} великий і славний. \q Розкажіть людям усюди про дивовижні речі, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив.

decisions.choice: glory: weight, splendor, honor
decisions.reason: The word (kavod) is literally weight, and so the greatness and splendor of God that deserves honor.

decisions.choice: wonders: deeds beyond human power
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts, such as the rescue from Egypt (Exodus 3:20; 78:4).

decisions.choice: "народы" for "the peoples" here, as 1 Chronicles 16:24
decisions.reason: Through Psalms, 'ammim is "племена" where the English Literal or Balanced says "peoples", and goyim "народы" where it says "nations"; Readable may follow its English. The lines Psalm 96 and 105:1-15 copy from 1 Chronicles 16 keep that chapter's "народы" (here, verses 5 and 7, and 105:1), so the parallel reads the same; Psalm 96:10 and 96:13, which Chronicles does not have, say "племена".

decisions.choice: Word for word 1CH 16:24; nifle'otaw "奇しいみわざ" (L), "不思議なみわざ" (B), "驚くべきこと" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Chronicles 16:24, so its Japanese is kept; the wonders are deeds beyond human power (m2).

source.text: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For great [is] YHWH and to be praised exceedingly; to be feared [is] he above all gods.

en.L: For great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and greatly to be praised; \q to be feared [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} above all gods.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great and worthy of the highest praise; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} must be revered above every god.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} deserves all our praise. \q People should honor and fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} far more than any so-called god.

fr.L: Car grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et très digne de louange ; \q redoutable [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} par-dessus tous les dieux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand et digne des plus hautes louanges ; \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’il faut révérer, plus que tout dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mérite toutes nos louanges. \q Les gens devraient {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craindre bien plus que tous ces prétendus dieux.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu na wa kusifiwa sana; \q wa kuogopwa [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kuliko miungu yote.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu na anastahili sifa kuu kuliko zote; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapaswa kuheshimiwa kwa hofu kuliko kila mungu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anastahili sifa zetu zote. \q Watu wanapaswa kumheshimu na kumcha kuliko kitu chochote kiitwacho mungu.

es.L: Porque grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y digno de suprema alabanza; \q temible [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sobre todos los dioses.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande y digno de la más alta alabanza; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} debe ser reverenciado sobre todo dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} merece toda nuestra alabanza. \q La gente debe honrarlo y temerlo mucho más que a cualquier supuesto dios.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] vĩ đại và rất đáng được ca ngợi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là Đấng] đáng kính sợ hơn mọi thần.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vĩ đại và đáng được ca ngợi tột bậc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được tôn kính hơn mọi thần.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được chúng ta hết lòng ca ngợi. \q Người ta nên tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hơn mọi thứ người ta gọi là thần.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 크게 찬양받으실 분이시며, \q 모든 신들보다 경외받으실 분이시다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시니 가장 높은 찬양을 받으셔야 마땅하고, \q 그 어떤 신보다 경외를 받으셔야 할 분이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 우리의 모든 찬양을 받으실 만하다. \q 사람들은 신이라 불리는 어떤 것보다 그분을 훨씬 더 두려워하며 높여야 한다.

pt.L: Porque grande [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e muito digno de louvor; \q e temível [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} acima de todos os deuses.
pt.B: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é grande e digno do mais alto louvor; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deve ser temido acima de todos os deuses.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} merece todo o nosso louvor. \q As pessoas devem honrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} e temê-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} muito mais do que qualquer um desses chamados deuses.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነውና፤ እጅግም ሊመሰገን ይገባዋል፤ \q ከአማልክትም ሁሉ በላይ የሚፈራ እርሱ [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነውና፤ ከሁሉ የላቀ ምስጋናም ይገባዋል፤ \q ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ሊፈራ የሚገባው እርሱ ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው፤ ምስጋናችንም ሁሉ ይገባዋል። \q ሰዎች አማልክት ከሚሏቸው ሁሉ ይልቅ እርሱን ሊያከብሩትና ሊፈሩት ይገባል።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान और अति स्तुति के योग्य [हैं]; \q वे सब देवताओं से अधिक भय के योग्य [हैं]।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं और सबसे बढ़कर स्तुति के योग्य हैं; \q हर देवता से बढ़कर उनका भय माना जाए।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं, और वे हमारी सारी स्तुति के योग्य हैं। \q लोग उन सब से कहीं बढ़कर, जिन्हें वे देवता कहते हैं, उनका आदर करें और उनका भय मानें।

ru.L: Потому что велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и весьма достоин хвалы, \q страшен {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} превыше всех богов.
ru.B: Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик и достоин высшей хвалы; \q перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} надо благоговеть больше, чем перед любым богом.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} достоин всей нашей хвалы. \q Люди должны чтить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} и бояться {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} гораздо больше, чем любых так называемых богов.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大いなる方、大いに賛美されるべき方。 \q その方はすべての神々にまさって恐れられるべき方。
ja.B: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大で、この上なく賛美されるべき方。 \q どの神々にもまさって、畏れ敬われるべき方。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方で、あらゆる賛美を受けるにふさわしい。 \q 神々と呼ばれるどんなものよりも、その方を敬い、恐れるべきだ。

uk.L: Бо великий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} і вельми хвалений; \q страшний {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} понад усіх богів.
uk.B: Бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий і гідний найвищої хвали; \q перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} треба благоговіти більше, ніж перед будь-яким богом.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} гідний усієї нашої хвали. \q Люди мають шанувати {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} й боятися набагато більше, ніж будь-якого так званого бога.

decisions.choice: to be feared: to be held in awe
decisions.reason: The form (nora') means one who is to be feared, that is, honored with awe and reverence (47:3).

decisions.choice: above all gods
decisions.reason: As in 95:3, the other gods are not real rivals; verse 5 says what they are.

decisions.choice: any so-called god
decisions.reason: Readable prepares for verse 5, which says these gods are nothing (m2).

decisions.choice: "страшен он" without "и"
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 16:25, but the psalm's Hebrew has no "and" before "to be feared", so Literal leaves out the "и" that Chronicles has.

decisions.choice: Word for word 1CH 16:25
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Chronicles 16:25; to be feared is to be held in awe (m1), above all gods (m2).

source.text: כִּ֤י׀כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: For all [the] gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, but YHWH made [the] heavens.

en.L: For all the gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the heavens.
en.B: For every god the peoples serve is a mere nothing, an idol, \q but it was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made the heavens.
en.R: The gods of the other nations are only idols. They are nothing! \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the sky above us.

fr.L: Car tous les dieux des peuples [sont] des idoles de néant, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait les cieux.
fr.B: Car tous les dieux que servent les peuples ne sont que du vide, des idoles, \q mais c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a fait les cieux.
fr.R: Les dieux des autres nations ne sont que des idoles. Ils ne sont rien ! \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait le ciel au-dessus de nous.

sw.L: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa [ni] sanamu zisizo na kitu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alizifanya mbingu.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila mungu wanayemtumikia watu ni bure, ni sanamu tu, \q lakini ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyezifanya mbingu.
sw.R: Miungu ya mataifa mengine ni sanamu tu. Si kitu! \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliumba anga lililo juu yetu.

es.L: Porque todos los dioses de los pueblos [son] ídolos sin valor, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo los cielos.
es.B: Porque todo dios al que sirven los pueblos es pura nada, un ídolo, \q pero fue {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien hizo los cielos.
es.R: Los dioses de las otras naciones son solo ídolos. ¡No son nada! \q Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo el cielo que está sobre nosotros.

vi.L: Vì mọi thần của các dân [là] những hình tượng hư không, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Vì mọi thần mà các dân thờ chỉ là hư không, là hình tượng, \q nhưng chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên các tầng trời.
vi.R: Các thần của những dân khác chỉ là hình tượng. Chúng chẳng là gì cả! \q Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên bầu trời trên chúng ta.

ko.L: 참으로 백성들의 모든 신은 헛된 우상들이나, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘을 지으셨다.
ko.B: 백성들이 섬기는 신들은 모두 아무것도 아닌 우상일 뿐이지만, \q 하늘을 지으신 분은 바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: 다른 민족들의 신들은 우상일 뿐이다. 그것들은 아무것도 아니다! \q 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 우리 위의 하늘을 만드셨다.

pt.L: Porque todos os deuses dos povos [são] ídolos sem valor, \q mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez os céus.
pt.B: Porque todo deus que os povos servem é um nada, um ídolo, \q mas foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} quem fez os céus.
pt.R: Os deuses das outras nações são só ídolos. Eles não são nada! \q Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez o céu que está acima de nós.

am.L: የሕዝቦች አማልክት ሁሉ ከንቱ ጣዖታት [ናቸውና]፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።
am.B: ሕዝቦች የሚያመልኳቸው አማልክት ሁሉ ከንቱ ጣዖታት ናቸውና፤ \q ሰማይን የሠራ ግን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።
am.R: የሌሎች ሕዝቦች አማልክት ጣዖታት ብቻ ናቸው፤ ምንም አይደሉም! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን ከላይ ያለውን ሰማይ ሠራ።

hi.L: क्योंकि देश-देश के लोगों के सब देवता निकम्मी मूरतें [हैं], \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने आकाश को बनाया।
hi.B: क्योंकि जिन देवताओं की लोग सेवा करते हैं, वे सब कुछ भी नहीं, बस मूरतें हैं, \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही ने आकाश को बनाया।
hi.R: दूसरे देशों के देवता बस मूरतें हैं। वे कुछ भी नहीं! \q पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने हमारे ऊपर का आकाश बनाया।

ru.L: Потому что все боги народов — ничтожные идолы, \q а {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} создал небеса.
ru.B: Ведь все боги, которым служат народы, — пустое ничто, идолы, \q а небеса сотворил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Боги других народов — всего лишь идолы. Они ничто! \q А {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} создал небо над нами.

ja.L: まことに、もろもろの民の神々はみな、むなしい偶像である。 \q しかし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は天を造られた。
ja.B: 諸国の民が仕える神々はみな、むなしいもの、偶像にすぎない。 \q しかし、天を造られたのは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}である。
ja.R: ほかの国々の神々は、ただの偶像だ。何の力もない！ \q しかし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしたちの上に広がる天を造られた。

uk.L: Бо всі боги народів — марні ідоли, \q а {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} створив небеса.
uk.B: Бо кожен бог, якому служать народи, — ніщо, просто ідол, \q а небеса створив саме {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Боги інших народів — лише ідоли. Вони ніщо! \q А {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} створив небо над нами.

decisions.choice: worthless idols: nothings
decisions.reason: The word ('elilim) means worthless things and is used for idols. It sounds like the word for gods ('elohim), a play on words: the gods of the peoples are no-gods (Isaiah 2:8; Leviticus 19:4).

decisions.choice: made the heavens: the Creator above the gods
decisions.reason: The nations' gods were made by people; the LORD made the sky, where the nations placed their gods. That is the proof of who is God (115:3-4).

decisions.choice: "des idoles de néant" at Literal, keeping the Hebrew play between ʾelohim (gods) and ʾelilim (nothings)
decisions.reason: French cannot keep the sound play; "idoles de néant" keeps both senses of the Hebrew word, an idol and a thing of no worth.

decisions.choice: Word for word 1CH 16:26; 'elilim "むなしい偶像"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Chronicles 16:26; the idols are nothings (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Splendor and majesty [are] before him; strength and beauty [are] in his sanctuary.

en.L: Splendor and majesty [are] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q strength and beauty [are] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary.
en.B: Splendor and majesty stand in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence; \q strength and beauty fill {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy place.
en.R: Glory and royal greatness surround {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Power and beauty fill the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives.

fr.L: La splendeur et la majesté [sont] devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q la force et la beauté [sont] dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire.
fr.B: La splendeur et la majesté se tiennent en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence ; \q la force et la beauté remplissent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu saint.
fr.R: La gloire et la grandeur royale {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent. \q La puissance et la beauté remplissent le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite.

sw.L: Fahari na enzi [viko] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q nguvu na uzuri [viko] katika patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}.
sw.B: Fahari na enzi vimesimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q nguvu na uzuri vimejaa mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu.
sw.R: Utukufu na ukuu wa kifalme vinamzunguka. \q Nguvu na uzuri vimejaa mahali anapoishi.

es.L: Esplendor y majestad [hay] delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q poder y hermosura [hay] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario.
es.B: El esplendor y la majestad están en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia; \q el poder y la belleza llenan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar santo.
es.R: La gloria y la grandeza real {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodean. \q El poder y la belleza llenan el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive.

vi.L: Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi [ở] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q sức mạnh và vẻ đẹp [ở] trong nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q sức mạnh và vẻ đẹp tràn ngập nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vinh quang và sự cao cả của bậc đế vương bao quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Quyền năng và vẻ đẹp tràn ngập nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.

ko.L: 존귀와 위엄이 그분 앞에 [있고], \q 능력과 아름다움이 그분의 성소에 [있다].
ko.B: 존귀와 위엄이 그분 앞에 서 있고, \q 능력과 아름다움이 그분의 거룩한 곳에 가득하다.
ko.R: 영광과 왕다운 위엄이 그분을 둘러싸고 있다. \q 힘과 아름다움이 그분께서 계시는 곳에 가득하다.

pt.L: Esplendor e majestade [estão] diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}; \q força e beleza [estão] no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santuário.
pt.B: Esplendor e majestade estão na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença; \q força e beleza enchem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar santo.
pt.R: Glória e grandeza de rei estão ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q Poder e beleza enchem o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mora.

am.L: ግርማና ክብር በፊቱ [ናቸው]፤ \q ብርታትና ውበት በመቅደሱ [ናቸው]።
am.B: ግርማና ክብር በፊቱ ይቆማሉ፤ \q ብርታትና ውበት ቅዱሱን ስፍራውን ሞልተዋል።
am.R: ክብርና የንጉሥ ታላቅነት ከበውታል። \q ኃይልና ውበት በሚኖርበት ስፍራ ሞልተዋል።

hi.L: प्रताप और ऐश्वर्य उनके सामने [हैं]; \q सामर्थ्य और शोभा उनके पवित्रस्थान में [हैं]।
hi.B: प्रताप और ऐश्वर्य उनकी उपस्थिति में रहते हैं; \q सामर्थ्य और शोभा उनके पवित्रस्थान को भर देते हैं।
hi.R: महिमा और राजसी वैभव उन्हें घेरे रहते हैं। \q जहाँ वे रहते हैं, वह जगह सामर्थ्य और सुंदरता से भरी है।

ru.L: Великолепие и величие перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; \q сила и красота во святилище {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Великолепие и величие стоят перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; \q сила и красота наполняют {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святилище.
ru.R: Слава и царское величие окружают {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \q Сила и красота наполняют место, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} живёт.

ja.L: 威光と威厳がその前にあり、 \q 力と輝きがその聖所にある。
ja.B: 輝きと威厳がその御前にあり、 \q 力と美しさが、その方の聖所に満ちている。
ja.R: 栄光と王の偉大さが、その方を取り囲んでいる。 \q その方の住まわれる所には、力と美しさが満ちている。

uk.L: Пишність і велич — перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}; \q сила й краса — у {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святилищі.
uk.B: Пишність і велич стоять перед {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} обличчям; \q сила й краса наповнюють {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святе місце.
uk.R: Слава й царська велич оточують {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. \q Сила й краса наповнюють місце, де {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} живе.

decisions.choice: splendor and majesty: the glory of a king
decisions.reason: The pair (hod, hadar) is used of a king's splendor (21:6; 45:4). Here they stand before the LORD like attendants at his throne.

decisions.choice: 1 Chronicles 16:27
decisions.reason: The parallel in 1 Chronicles 16:27 reads "strength and joy are in his place"; there the ark had not yet a temple.

decisions.choice: the place where he lives
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sanctuary is: God's holy house.

decisions.choice: "ውበት" (beauty) and "መቅደሱ" (his sanctuary), where 1 Chronicles 16:27 has "ደስታ" (joy) and "ስፍራው" (his place); the first line as Chronicles
decisions.reason: The psalm's Hebrew differs from Chronicles in these two words (the meaning decision), so the Amharic follows the psalm there and copies Chronicles elsewhere.

decisions.choice: "शोभा" (L, B), "सुंदरता" (R); "पवित्रस्थान" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Where 1 Chronicles 16:27 has "strength and joy in his place", the psalm has "strength and beauty in his sanctuary" (meaning m2). The first line keeps the Hindi of Chronicles; the second changes only those words: beauty is "शोभा" (L, B) and "सुंदरता" (R), the sanctuary "पवित्रस्थान", as in the Pentateuch. Readable keeps "the place where he lives" as in Chronicles, since its English does.

decisions.choice: "красота", "святилище"
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 16:27 has "strength and joy in his place"; the psalm has "beauty" and "his sanctuary", so the second line differs there and keeps the rest of that verse's wording.

decisions.choice: First line as 1CH 16:27; second line 'oz vetif'eret bemiqdasho "力と輝きがその聖所に" (L), "力と美しさが、その方の聖所に" (B), "力と美しさ" (R)
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 16:27 (m2) reads 'strength and joy in his place'; the psalm has 'strength and beauty in his sanctuary', so only those words change. tif'eret 輝き at L as 71:8.

source.text: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to YHWH, clans of [the] peoples, ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, families of the peoples, \q ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and strength.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} what is due, you families of the nations; \q give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and might.
en.R: Give honor to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you families and nations! \q Say that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is glorious and strong.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, familles des peuples, \q rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et force.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est dû, familles des nations ; \q donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et puissance.
fr.R: Rendez honneur {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous toutes, familles et nations ! \q Dites que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est glorieux et fort.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi jamaa za mataifa, \q mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na nguvu.
sw.B: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachostahili, enyi jamaa za mataifa; \q mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na uweza.
sw.R: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} heshima, enyi jamaa zote na mataifa! \q Semeni kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mtukufu na mwenye nguvu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, familias de los pueblos, \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y poder.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lo que le corresponde, familias de las naciones; \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y fuerza.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todas las familias y naciones! \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es glorioso y fuerte.

vi.L: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi các dòng họ của các dân, \q hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang và sức mạnh.
vi.B: Hỡi các dòng họ của các dân tộc, hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng nhận; \q hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang và quyền năng.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi gia tộc và mọi dân tộc, hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy nói rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh hiển và mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌려라, 백성들의 족속들아, \q 영광과 능력을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌려라.
ko.B: 민족들의 모든 가문들아, 마땅한 것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라. \q 영광과 능력을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라.
ko.R: 모든 가문과 민족들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 높여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 영광스럽고 강하시다고 말하여라.

pt.L: Atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, famílias dos povos, \q atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} glória e força.
pt.B: Deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} é devido, famílias das nações; \q deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} glória e poder.
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todas as famílias e nações! \q Digam que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é glorioso e forte.

am.L: የሕዝቦች ጎሳዎች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ፤ \q ክብርንና ብርታትን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ።
am.B: የሕዝቦች ጎሳዎች ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የሚገባውን ስጡ፤ \q ክብርንና ኃይልን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ።
am.R: ጎሳዎችና ሕዝቦች ሁሉ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አክብሩ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ክቡርና ብርቱ እንደ ሆነ ተናገሩ።

hi.L: हे देश-देश के कुलो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को दो, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को महिमा और सामर्थ्य दो।
hi.B: हे देशों के कुलो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को वह दो जो उनका हक़ है; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को महिमा और सामर्थ्य दो।
hi.R: हे सब कुलो और देशो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर करो! \q मान लो कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महिमावान और सामर्थी हैं।

ru.L: Воздайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, роды народов, \q воздайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} славу и силу.
ru.B: Отдайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} должное, роды народов; \q отдайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} славу и могущество.
ru.R: Воздайте честь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, все роды и народы! \q Говорите, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} славен и силён.

ja.L: もろもろの民の諸氏族よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。 \q 栄光と力を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。
ja.B: 諸国の民の家族たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にふさわしいものを帰せよ。 \q 栄光と力を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。
ja.R: すべての家族、すべての国々よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をたたえよ！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は栄光に満ち、力ある方だと言い表せ。

uk.L: Віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, роди народів, \q віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} славу й силу.
uk.B: Віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} належне, роди народів; \q віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} славу й могутність.
uk.R: Віддайте честь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, усі роди й народи! \q Визнайте, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} славний і сильний.

decisions.choice: ascribe: give, acknowledge
decisions.reason: The verb (yahav) is simply "give"; giving glory and strength to God is acknowledging that they are his.

decisions.choice: Psalm 29:1-2
decisions.reason: Verses 7-9 echo 29:1-2, where the same call is made to the heavenly beings; here it goes out to the families of all the peoples (Genesis 12:3).

decisions.choice: Word for word 1CH 16:28; havu "帰せよ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Chronicles 16:28; ascribe is give, acknowledge (m1), as in 29:1-2 (m2).

source.text: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ־מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to YHWH [the] glory of his name; lift up an offering and come into his courts.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q lift up an offering and come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} courts.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves; \q bring a gift and enter {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} courts.
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves. \q Bring a gift to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and come into the courtyards of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez une offrande et entrez dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} parvis.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire que mérite {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez un don et entrez dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} parvis.
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom le mérite. \q Apportez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un don et entrez dans les cours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu wa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q leteni sadaka mkaingie katika nyua {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu unaostahili jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q leteni zawadi mkaingie nyuani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}.
sw.R: Mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} linavyostahili. \q Mleteeni zawadi na kuingia katika viwanja vya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} una ofrenda y {{plural_you:entren|entrad}} en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} atrios.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria que merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} un presente y {{plural_you:entren|entrad}} en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} atrios.
es.R: {{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q {{plural_you:Tráiganle|Traedle}} un regalo y {{plural_you:entren|entrad}} en los patios de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo.

vi.L: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy đem lễ vật và vào các sân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang xứng với danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy mang lễ vật vào các sân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được tôn vinh. \q Hãy mang lễ vật đến cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vào sân đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 그분 이름의 영광을 돌려라. \q 예물을 들고 그분의 뜰로 들어가거라.
ko.B: 그분의 이름에 마땅한 영광을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라. \q 예물을 가지고 그분의 뜰에 들어가거라.
ko.R: 그분의 이름에 맞게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 높여라. \q 그분께 예물을 가지고 성전 뜰로 들어가거라.

pt.L: Atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a glória do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q tragam uma oferta e entrem nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} átrios.
pt.B: Deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a glória que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome merece; \q tragam uma oferta e entrem nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pátios.
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome merece. \q Tragam uma oferta a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e entrem nos pátios do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.

am.L: የስሙን ክብር {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ፤ \q እጅ መንሻ ይዛችሁ ወደ አደባባዮቹ ግቡ።
am.B: ለስሙ የሚገባውን ክብር {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስጡ፤ \q እጅ መንሻ ይዛችሁ ወደ አደባባዮቹ ግቡ።
am.R: ለስሙ በሚገባው መጠን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አክብሩ። \q ስጦታ ይዛችሁ ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ አደባባዮች ኑ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को उनके नाम की महिमा दो; \q भेंट लेकर उनके आँगनों में आओ।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को वह महिमा दो जिसके योग्य उनका नाम है; \q भेंट लेकर उनके आँगनों में प्रवेश करो।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का ऐसा आदर करो जैसा उनके नाम के योग्य है। \q उनके लिए भेंट लेकर उनके मंदिर के आँगनों में आओ।

ru.L: Воздайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} славу имени {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}; \q несите дар и входите во дворы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Отдайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} славу, достойную {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имени; \q принесите дар и войдите в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} дворы.
ru.R: Чтите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, как того достойно {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя. \q Принесите {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} дар и придите во дворы {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} храма.

ja.L: その名の栄光を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。 \q ささげ物を携えて、その庭に入れ。
ja.B: その名にふさわしい栄光を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に帰せよ。 \q ささげ物を携えて、その方の庭に入れ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、その名にふさわしくたたえよ。 \q ささげ物を持って、その方の神殿の庭に入れ。

uk.L: Віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} славу {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імені; \q принесіть дар і ввійдіть у {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} подвірʼя.
uk.B: Віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} славу, на яку заслуговує {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя; \q принесіть дар і ввійдіть у {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} подвірʼя.
uk.R: Шануйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, як того гідне {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя. \q Принесіть {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} дар і ввійдіть на подвірʼя {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} храму.

decisions.choice: an offering: a gift or tribute
decisions.reason: The word (minchah) is a gift, the tribute brought to a king (2 Samuel 8:2), and the grain offering of the temple (Leviticus 2:1). The nations come like subjects to their King.

decisions.choice: his courts: the courtyards of the temple
decisions.reason: Worshipers gathered in the open courts around the temple building.

decisions.choice: of his temple
decisions.reason: Readable says whose courts these are.

decisions.choice: "ወደ አደባባዮቹ ግቡ" (come into his courts), where 1 Chronicles 16:29 has "come before him"; the rest as Chronicles
decisions.reason: The psalm names the temple courts, Chronicles (set before the temple was built) says "before him"; the Amharic follows each Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "उनके आँगनों में" for "into his courts"
decisions.reason: Where 1 Chronicles 16:29 says "come before him", the psalm says "come into his courts", the temple courtyards (meaning m2). The rest of the verse keeps the Hindi of Chronicles; Readable adds "मंदिर" as its English adds "temple".

decisions.choice: "дворы"
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 16:29 has "come before him"; the psalm has "into his courts" (m2), so that phrase differs and the rest keeps the Chronicles wording.

decisions.choice: As 1CH 16:29a-b, with uvo'u lechatsrotaw "その庭に入れ" (L), "その方の庭に入れ" (B), "その方の神殿の庭に入れ" (R) for 1CH's 'come before him'
decisions.reason: The psalm has 'come into his courts' where 1 Chronicles 16:29 has 'come before him'; the courts are the courtyards of the temple (m2), as R says with the English R.

source.text: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bow down to YHWH in [the] adornment of holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

en.L: Bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in [the] splendor of holiness; \q tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all the earth.
en.B: Bow low before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in holy splendor; \q tremble in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence, all the earth.
en.R: Bow down and worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is holy and glorious. \q Everyone on earth, tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Prosternez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans [la] splendeur de la sainteté ; \q tremblez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toute la terre.
fr.B: Inclinez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans une sainte splendeur ; \q tremblez en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence, terre entière.
fr.R: Inclinez-vous et adorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est saint et glorieux. \q Vous tous qui êtes sur la terre, tremblez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !

sw.L: Msujudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika uzuri wa utakatifu; \q tetemekeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, dunia yote.
sw.B: Inameni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika fahari takatifu; \q tetemekeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, dunia yote.
sw.R: Inameni mkamwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliye mtakatifu na mtukufu. \q Kila mtu duniani, tetemekeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!

es.L: {{plural_you:Póstrense|Postraos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en [el] esplendor de la santidad; \q {{plural_you:tiemblen|temblad}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, toda la tierra.
es.B: {{plural_you:Inclínense|Inclinaos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en santo esplendor; \q {{plural_you:tiemblen|temblad}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia, toda la tierra.
es.R: {{plural_you:Inclínense|Inclinaos}} y {{plural_you:adoren|adorad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que es santo y glorioso. \q ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:tiemblen|temblad}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!

vi.L: Hãy cúi lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong vẻ huy hoàng của sự thánh khiết; \q hãy run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi cả trái đất.
vi.B: Hãy sấp mình trước {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong vẻ huy hoàng thánh khiết; \q hỡi cả trái đất, hãy run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy cúi lạy và thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng thánh khiết và vinh hiển. \q Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 거룩함의 광채로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 엎드려 절하여라. \q 온 땅아, 그분 앞에서 떨어라.
ko.B: 거룩한 광채 가운데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 엎드려 절하여라. \q 온 땅아, 그분 앞에서 떨어라.
ko.R: 거룩하고 영광스러우신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 엎드려 예배하여라. \q 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, 그분 앞에서 떨어라!

pt.L: Prostrem-se diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} no esplendor da santidade; \q tremam diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, toda a terra.
pt.B: Curvem-se diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em santo esplendor; \q tremam na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença, toda a terra!
pt.R: Curvem-se e adorem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que é santo e glorioso. \q Todos na terra, tremam diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}!

am.L: በቅድስና ግርማ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስገዱ፤ \q ምድር ሁሉ፣ በፊቱ ተንቀጥቀጡ።
am.B: በቅዱስ ግርማ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስገዱ፤ \q ምድር ሁሉ፣ በፊቱ ተንቀጥቀጡ!
am.R: ቅዱስና ክቡር ለሆነው {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ተደፍታችሁ ስገዱ። \q በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ፣ በፊቱ ተንቀጥቀጡ!

hi.L: पवित्रता की शोभा में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को दंडवत करो; \q हे सारी पृथ्वी, उनके सामने काँपो।
hi.B: पवित्र शोभा में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के आगे झुककर दंडवत करो; \q हे सारी पृथ्वी, उनकी उपस्थिति में थरथराओ।
hi.R: झुककर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आराधना करो, जो पवित्र और महिमावान हैं। \q पृथ्वी के सब लोगो, उनके सामने काँपो!

ru.L: Поклонитесь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} в великолепии святости; \q трепещите перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, вся земля.
ru.B: Низко поклонитесь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} в святом великолепии; \q трепещите перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, вся земля!
ru.R: Склонитесь до земли и поклонитесь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, который свят и славен. \q Все люди на земле, трепещите перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}!

ja.L: 聖なる輝きのうちに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にひれ伏せ。 \q 全地よ、その前におののけ。
ja.B: 聖なる輝きのうちに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前にひれ伏せ。 \q 全地よ、御前におののけ！
ja.R: 聖なる、栄光に満ちた{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にひれ伏して礼拝せよ。 \q 地上のすべての人々よ、その方の前で震えおののけ！

uk.L: Поклоніться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} у пишноті святості; \q тремти перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, уся земле.
uk.B: Низько вклоніться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} у святій пишноті; \q тремти перед {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} обличчям, уся земле.
uk.R: Вклоніться й поклоніться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, який святий і славний. \q Усі на землі, тремтіть перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}!

decisions.choice: the splendor of holiness: God's holy splendor
decisions.reason: The phrase (hadrat qodesh) may describe God's holy splendor, the setting of the worship, or the holy attire of those who worship (as in 29:2; 2 Chronicles 20:21). Literal keeps it open; Readable takes it of God.

decisions.choice: tremble: shake with awe
decisions.reason: The verb (chil) is to writhe or tremble, here in awe before the King.

decisions.choice: who is holy and glorious
decisions.reason: Readable takes the phrase of God himself (m1).

decisions.choice: First line as 1CH 16:29c, second as 1CH 16:30a; behadrat-qodesh "聖なる輝きのうちに"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins 1 Chronicles 16:29c and 16:30a, and both keep their Japanese. The splendor of holiness may be God's or the worshipers' attire (m1, uncertain, footnote); tremble is shaking with awe (m2).

source.text: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם׀יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף־תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Say among the nations, 'YHWH reigns! Yes, [the] world is established; it will not be shaken. He will judge [the] peoples with uprightness.'

en.L: Say among the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns! \q Indeed, the world is established; it will not be shaken. \q He will judge the peoples with uprightness."
en.B: Tell the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! \q The world stands firm; nothing can make it totter. \q He will judge the peoples fairly."
en.R: Tell all the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! \q He has made the world firm, so it cannot be shaken. \q He will judge all people fairly."

fr.L: Dites parmi les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ! \q Oui, le monde est affermi ; il ne sera pas ébranlé. \q Il jugera les peuples avec droiture. »
fr.B: Dites aux nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! \q Le monde tient ferme ; rien ne peut le faire chanceler. \q Il jugera les peuples avec équité. »
fr.R: Dites à toutes les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! \q Il a rendu le monde solide, et rien ne peut l’ébranler. \q Il jugera tous les peuples de façon juste. »

sw.L: Semeni kati ya mataifa, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala! \q Naam, ulimwengu umethibitishwa; hautatikisika. \q Atawahukumu watu kwa unyofu."
sw.B: Yaambieni mataifa, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! \q Ulimwengu umesimama imara; hakuna kitakachoufanya uyumbe. \q Atawahukumu watu kwa haki."
sw.R: Yaambieni mataifa yote, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! \q Ameufanya ulimwengu kuwa imara, hauwezi kutikiswa. \q Atawahukumu watu wote kwa haki."

es.L: {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} entre las naciones: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina! \q Ciertamente, el mundo está afirmado; no será sacudido. \q Él juzgará a los pueblos con rectitud».
es.B: {{plural_you:Díganles|Decidles}} a las naciones: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! \q El mundo está firme; nada lo puede hacer tambalear. \q Él juzgará a los pueblos con equidad».
es.R: {{plural_you:Díganles|Decidles}} a todas las naciones: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! \q Él ha hecho firme el mundo, y no se puede sacudir. \q Él juzgará a todos con justicia».

vi.L: Hãy nói giữa các dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trị vì! \q Thật vậy, thế gian được lập vững; nó sẽ không bị lay động. \q Ngài sẽ xét xử các dân cách ngay thẳng."
vi.B: Hãy nói cho các dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua! \q Thế gian đứng vững; không gì làm nó lung lay. \q Ngài sẽ xét xử các dân cách công minh."
vi.R: Hãy nói với mọi dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua! \q Ngài đã làm cho thế giới vững chắc, nên nó không thể bị lay chuyển. \q Ngài sẽ xét xử mọi người cách công bằng."

ko.L: 민족들 가운데서 말하여라. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다스리신다! \q 참으로 세상이 굳게 서서 흔들리지 않는다. \q 그분께서 백성들을 공정하게 심판하신다."
ko.B: 민족들에게 말하여라. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다! \q 세상이 굳게 서 있으니 아무것도 그것을 흔들 수 없다. \q 그분께서 백성들을 공정하게 재판하실 것이다."
ko.R: 모든 민족에게 말하여라. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다! \q 그분께서 세상을 든든히 세우셨으니, 세상은 흔들리지 않는다. \q 그분께서 모든 사람을 공정하게 심판하실 것이다."

pt.L: Digam entre as nações: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} reina! \q Sim, o mundo está firme; não será abalado. \q Ele julgará os povos com retidão."
pt.B: Digam às nações: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei! \q O mundo está firme; nada pode fazê-lo vacilar. \q Ele julgará os povos com justiça."
pt.R: Digam a todas as nações: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei! \q Ele firmou o mundo, e por isso o mundo não pode ser abalado. \q Ele vai julgar todas as pessoas com justiça."

am.L: በሕዝቦች መካከል እንዲህ በሉ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነገሠ! \q ዓለምም በእርግጥ ጸንታለች፤ አትናወጥም። \q ለወገኖች በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።»
am.B: ለሕዝቦች እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ንጉሥ ነው! \q ዓለም ጸንታ ቆማለች፤ ምንም አያነቃንቃትም። \q ለወገኖች በትክክል ይፈርዳል።»
am.R: ለሕዝቦች ሁሉ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ንጉሥ ነው! \q ዓለምን አጽንቷታል፤ ስለዚህ አትናወጥም። \q ለሰዎች ሁሉ በትክክል ይፈርዳል።»

hi.L: जातियों में कहो, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं! \q हाँ, जगत स्थिर है; वह टलेगा नहीं। \q वे सीधाई से देश-देश के लोगों का न्याय करेंगे।"
hi.B: देशों से कहो, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं! \q जगत दृढ़ खड़ा है; कोई उसे डगमगा नहीं सकता। \q वे देश-देश के लोगों का न्याय निष्पक्षता से करेंगे।"
hi.R: सब देशों को बताओ, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं! \q उन्होंने जगत को दृढ़ किया है, इसलिए वह हिलाया नहीं जा सकता। \q वे सब लोगों का न्याय निष्पक्षता से करेंगे।"

ru.L: Говорите среди народов: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} царствует! \q И вот, утверждена вселенная, не поколеблется. \q Он будет судить племена по правоте.»
ru.B: Скажите народам: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Царь! \q Мир стоит твёрдо; ничто не сдвинет его. \q Он будет судить племена справедливо.»
ru.R: Скажите всем народам: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Царь! \q Он сделал мир прочным, и его нельзя поколебать. \q Он будет судить всех людей справедливо.»

ja.L: 諸国の民の中で言え。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は王として治められる！ \q まことに、世界は堅く立てられ、揺るがされることはない。 \q その方は、公平をもってもろもろの民をお裁きになる。」
ja.B: 諸国の民に告げよ。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ王である！ \q 世界は堅く据えられ、揺るぐことはない。 \q その方は、もろもろの民を公平にお裁きになる。」
ja.R: すべての国々に伝えよ。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ王だ！ \q その方が世界を堅く据えられたので、世界は揺るがない。 \q その方は、すべての人を公平にお裁きになる。」

uk.L: Скажіть серед народів: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} царює! \q Справді, світ утверджений; він не похитнеться. \q Він судитиме народи справедливо.»
uk.B: Скажіть народам: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Цар! \q Світ стоїть твердо; ніщо не може його захитати. \q Він судитиме народи чесно.»
uk.R: Скажіть усім народам: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Цар! \q Він зробив світ твердим, тож його не можна похитнути. \q Він судитиме всіх людей справедливо.»

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken the throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) with the LORD as subject is the cry of Psalms 93, 96, 97 and 99. The same form was shouted when a new king took the throne (2 Samuel 15:10; 2 Kings 9:13), so it may also mean "has become King": the LORD is acclaimed as King over all the earth.

decisions.choice: Psalm 93:1
decisions.reason: "The world is established; it will not be shaken" repeats 93:1. Because the LORD is King, the world he made holds firm.

decisions.choice: judge with uprightness: rule fairly
decisions.reason: The verb (din) is to judge or govern; "uprightness" (mesharim) is what is level and fair. The King's judging means setting things right.

decisions.choice: is King
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "is King", the plain sense of the royal cry; Literal keeps "reigns".

decisions.choice: He has made
decisions.reason: Readable names who made the world firm, which the passive verb implies.

decisions.choice: the lines of 1 Chronicles 16:30b-31b in the psalm's order, with the psalm's own last line ("ለወገኖች በቅንነት ይፈርዳል"); "ዓለምም በእርግጥ ጸንታለች፤ አትናወጥም" as Chronicles and Psalm 93:1
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "the world is established" before "say among the nations, The LORD reigns" and lacks the line on judging the peoples; the shared lines keep its Amharic.

decisions.choice: the cry "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं!" (L), "... राजा हैं!" (B, R); the last line
decisions.reason: The first two lines are 1 Chronicles 16:31b and 16:30b at each level, in the order of the psalm, with the cry of the kingship psalms in its one wording (see 93:1). Chronicles has "let them say" where the psalm says "say", so the verb is "कहो" (L) and "कहो"/"बताओ" (B, R). The last line, which Chronicles lacks, is translated here: the King's judging sets things right (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ царствует!" (L); "ГОСПОДЬ — Царь!" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The royal cry and the line about the world keep the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:31 and 16:30, as in Psalms 93-99. The last line, which Chronicles does not have, is new; "the peoples" are "племена", by the rule recorded at verse 3.

decisions.choice: YHWH malakh as 1CH 16:31 and 93:1; 'af-tikkon tevel bal-timmot as 1CH 16:30b; yadin 'ammim bemesharim "公平をもって…お裁きになる" (L), "公平にお裁きになる" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The psalm says 'say among the nations' where 1 Chronicles 16:31 has 'let them say', and adds the line on judging, so the frame and the last line are new; the cry and the firm world keep the Chronicles Japanese (m1, uncertain; m2). To judge with uprightness is to rule fairly (m3); お裁きになる, not 裁かれる, which reads as a passive.

source.text: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad; let the sea thunder and its fullness.

en.L: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad; \q let the sea thunder, and its fullness.
en.B: Let the heavens be full of joy and the earth be glad; \q let the sea thunder with all that lives in it.
en.R: Let the sky and the earth be happy! \q Let the sea and all the creatures in it roar!

fr.L: Que les cieux se réjouissent et que la terre soit dans l’allégresse ; \q que gronde la mer et ce qui la remplit.
fr.B: Que les cieux soient pleins de joie et la terre en fête ; \q que la mer gronde avec tout ce qui vit en elle.
fr.R: Que le ciel et la terre soient heureux ! \q Que la mer et tous les animaux qui y vivent fassent entendre leur bruit !

sw.L: Mbingu na zifurahi na nchi ishangilie; \q bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo.
sw.B: Mbingu na zijae furaha na nchi ishangilie; \q bahari na ivume pamoja na vyote vinavyoishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Anga na nchi na zifurahi! \q Bahari na viumbe vyote vilivyomo na vivume!

es.L: Alégrense los cielos y gócese la tierra; \q brame el mar y lo que lo llena.
es.B: Que los cielos se llenen de alegría y la tierra se goce; \q que brame el mar con todo lo que vive en él.
es.R: ¡Que el cielo y la tierra estén felices! \q ¡Que rujan el mar y todas las criaturas que hay en él!

vi.L: Hãy để các tầng trời vui mừng và đất hân hoan; \q hãy để biển gầm vang, cùng muôn vật đầy dẫy trong đó.
vi.B: Nguyện các tầng trời tràn đầy vui mừng và đất hân hoan; \q nguyện biển cả gầm vang cùng mọi loài sống trong đó.
vi.R: Hỡi trời và đất, hãy vui mừng! \q Hỡi biển cả và mọi sinh vật trong biển, hãy gầm vang!

ko.L: 하늘은 기뻐하고 땅은 즐거워하여라. \q 바다와 그 안에 가득한 것은 우렁차게 외쳐라.
ko.B: 하늘은 기쁨에 넘치고 땅은 즐거워하여라. \q 바다와 그 안에 사는 모든 것은 우렁차게 소리쳐라.
ko.R: 하늘과 땅아, 기뻐하여라! \q 바다와 그 안의 모든 생물들아, 크게 외쳐라!

pt.L: Alegrem-se os céus, e exulte a terra; \q troveje o mar e a sua plenitude.
pt.B: Que os céus se encham de alegria e a terra se alegre; \q que o mar troveje com tudo o que vive nele.
pt.R: Que o céu e a terra fiquem felizes! \q Que o mar e todos os seres que vivem nele rujam!

am.L: ሰማያት ደስ ይበላቸው፤ ምድርም ሐሤት ታድርግ፤ \q ባሕርና ሞላዋ ይንጎድጓድ።
am.B: ሰማይ በደስታ ይሞላ፤ ምድርም ሐሤት ታድርግ፤ \q ባሕርና በውስጡ የሚኖር ሁሉ ይንጎድጓድ።
am.R: ሰማይና ምድር ደስ ይበላቸው! \q ባሕርና በውስጡ ያሉ ፍጥረታት ሁሉ ይጩኹ!

hi.L: आकाश आनंदित हो और पृथ्वी मगन हो; \q समुद्र और जो कुछ उसमें भरा है, गरजे।
hi.B: आकाश आनंद से भर जाए और पृथ्वी मगन हो; \q समुद्र और उसमें रहनेवाले सब गरजें।
hi.R: आकाश और पृथ्वी ख़ुश हों! \q समुद्र और उसके सब जीव-जंतु गरजें!

ru.L: Пусть радуются небеса, и пусть ликует земля; \q пусть шумит море и то, что наполняет его.
ru.B: Пусть небеса будут полны радости и земля веселится; \q пусть гремит море со всем, что в нём живёт.
ru.R: Пусть радуются небо и земля! \q Пусть ревут море и все существа в нём!

ja.L: 天は喜び、地は楽しむように。 \q 海とそれに満ちるものはとどろけ。
ja.B: 天は喜びにあふれ、地は楽しめ。 \q 海と、そこに生きるすべてのものはとどろけ。
ja.R: 空も地も喜べ！ \q 海も、海に住むすべての生き物も、とどろけ！

uk.L: Нехай веселяться небеса, і нехай радіє земля; \q нехай гримить море і все, що його наповнює.
uk.B: Нехай небеса сповняться радістю, а земля веселиться; \q нехай гримить море з усім, що живе в ньому.
uk.R: Нехай радіють небо й земля! \q Нехай ревуть море і всі створіння в ньому!

decisions.choice: its fullness: all that fills the sea
decisions.reason: The word (melo') is what fills something; here the creatures of the sea (24:1).

decisions.choice: the sea joins the praise
decisions.reason: The sea is often a picture of chaos and threat (93:3-4); here even the sea thunders in praise of its King. Psalm 98:7 repeats the line.

decisions.choice: First line as 1CH 16:31a, second as 1CH 16:32a
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Chronicles 16:31a and 16:32a; its fullness is all that fills the sea (m1), which joins the praise (m2).

source.text: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] field exult and all that [is] in it; then all [the] trees of [the] forest will shout for joy

en.L: Let the field exult and all that [is] in it; \q then all the trees of the forest will shout for joy,
en.B: Let the fields and everything in them celebrate; \q then every tree in the woods will cry out with joy,
en.R: Let the fields and everything in them be glad. \q Then all the trees in the forest will sing for joy.

fr.L: Que les champs exultent et tout ce qui [est] en eux ; \q alors tous les arbres de la forêt crieront de joie
fr.B: Que les champs et tout ce qu’ils portent soient dans la joie ; \q alors tous les arbres des bois crieront de joie
fr.R: Que les champs et tout ce qui s’y trouve soient joyeux. \q Alors tous les arbres de la forêt chanteront de joie.

sw.L: Shamba na lishangilie na vyote vilivyomo; \q ndipo miti yote ya msituni itapiga kelele za furaha,
sw.B: Mashamba na vyote vilivyomo na visherehekee; \q ndipo kila mti wa msituni utalia kwa furaha,
sw.R: Mashamba na vyote vilivyomo na vifurahi. \q Ndipo miti yote ya msituni itaimba kwa furaha.

es.L: Regocíjese el campo y todo lo que [hay] en él; \q entonces todos los árboles del bosque gritarán de júbilo,
es.B: Que los campos y todo lo que hay en ellos celebren; \q entonces cada árbol del bosque clamará de alegría,
es.R: Que se alegren los campos y todo lo que hay en ellos. \q Entonces todos los árboles del bosque cantarán de alegría.

vi.L: Hãy để đồng ruộng cùng mọi vật [ở] trong đó hớn hở; \q bấy giờ mọi cây cối trong rừng sẽ reo hát vui mừng,
vi.B: Nguyện đồng ruộng và mọi vật trong đó hân hoan; \q bấy giờ mọi cây trong rừng sẽ reo lên vui mừng,
vi.R: Hỡi đồng ruộng và mọi vật trong đó, hãy vui lên. \q Rồi mọi cây cối trong rừng sẽ hát vui mừng.

ko.L: 들과 그 안에 있는 모든 것은 크게 기뻐하여라. \q 그때 숲의 모든 나무가 기뻐 노래할 것이다.
ko.B: 들판과 그 안의 모든 것은 즐거워하여라. \q 그때 숲의 나무들이 모두 기뻐 외칠 것이다.
ko.R: 들판과 그 안의 모든 것은 기뻐하여라. \q 그러면 숲의 모든 나무들이 기뻐 노래할 것이다.

pt.L: Exulte o campo e tudo o que [há] nele; \q então todas as árvores da floresta gritarão de alegria,
pt.B: Que os campos e tudo o que há neles façam festa; \q então todas as árvores do bosque vão clamar de alegria,
pt.R: Que os campos e tudo o que há neles fiquem alegres. \q Então todas as árvores da floresta vão cantar de alegria.

am.L: ሜዳውና በእርሱ ያለው ሁሉ ሐሤት ያድርግ፤ \q ያን ጊዜ የዱር ዛፎች ሁሉ እልል ይላሉ፣
am.B: ሜዳዎችና በእነርሱ ያለው ሁሉ ደስ ይበላቸው፤ \q ያን ጊዜ የጫካ ዛፎች ሁሉ በደስታ ይዘምራሉ፣
am.R: ሜዳዎችና በእነርሱ ያለው ሁሉ ደስ ይበላቸው። \q ያን ጊዜ በጫካ ያሉ ዛፎች ሁሉ በደስታ ይዘምራሉ።

hi.L: मैदान और जो कुछ उसमें है, प्रफुल्लित हो; \q तब वन के सब वृक्ष जयजयकार करेंगे,
hi.B: खेत और उनमें की हर वस्तु उत्सव मनाए; \q तब जंगल का हर पेड़ आनंद से जयजयकार करेगा,
hi.R: खेत और उनमें की हर चीज़ आनंदित हो। \q तब जंगल के सब पेड़ आनंद से गाएँगे।

ru.L: Пусть ликует поле и всё, что на нём; \q тогда возликуют все деревья леса,
ru.B: Пусть поля и всё, что на них, торжествуют; \q тогда каждое дерево в лесу закричит от радости,
ru.R: Пусть радуются поля и всё, что на них. \q Тогда все деревья в лесу запоют от радости.

ja.L: 野とそこにあるすべてのものは喜び躍れ。 \q そのとき、森のすべての木々は喜び叫ぶ、
ja.B: 野と、そこにあるすべてのものは喜び祝え。 \q そのとき、森のすべての木々も喜びの声を上げる、
ja.R: 野原も、そこにあるすべてのものも、喜べ。 \q そのとき、森のすべての木々も喜んで歌う。

uk.L: Нехай тріумфує поле і все, що на ньому; \q тоді всі дерева лісу радісно заспівають,
uk.B: Нехай поля й усе, що на них, святкують; \q тоді кожне дерево в лісі закричить від радості,
uk.R: Нехай радіють поля і все, що на них. \q Тоді всі дерева в лісі співатимуть від радості.

decisions.choice: the trees shout for joy: creation welcomes its King
decisions.reason: The poem pictures the whole creation, sky, sea, fields and forest, celebrating the King's coming, as in Isaiah 55:12.

decisions.choice: then: when the LORD comes
decisions.reason: "Then" points to the moment named in verse 13, when the LORD comes to judge.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: "Before the LORD" in verse 13 completes this line, so the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: "सब" (L), "हर" (B) with the trees
decisions.reason: The psalm has "all the trees", where 1 Chronicles 16:33 has "the trees"; otherwise the verse keeps the Hindi of 1 Chronicles 16:32b-33a.

decisions.choice: As 1CH 16:32b-33a, with kol 'atsei-ya'ar "森のすべての木々" (1CH has no kol)
decisions.reason: The psalm adds 'all' to the trees, so すべての is added to the Chronicles Japanese. The trees welcome their King (m1) when the LORD comes (m2); L and B run on into 96:13 as the English (m3), R ends the verse.

source.text: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: before YHWH, for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge [the] world with righteousness and [the] peoples with his faithfulness.

en.L: before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes to judge the earth. \q He will judge the world with righteousness \q and the peoples with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithfulness.
en.B: in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is on the way, on the way to judge the earth. \q He will bring justice to the world \q and judge its peoples by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own faithfulness.
en.R: They will sing in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming. He is coming to rule the earth as judge. \q He will judge the world with justice \q and treat all peoples with faithfulness.

fr.L: devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient juger la terre. \q Il jugera le monde avec justice \q et les peuples selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fidélité.
fr.B: devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en chemin, en chemin pour juger la terre. \q Il fera justice au monde \q et jugera ses peuples selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre fidélité.
fr.R: Ils chanteront devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient. Il vient gouverner la terre comme juge. \q Il jugera le monde avec justice \q et traitera tous les peuples avec fidélité.

sw.L: mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana anakuja, kwa maana anakuja kuihukumu nchi. \q Atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki \q na mataifa kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana yuko njiani, njiani kuja kuihukumu nchi. \q Ataleta haki ulimwenguni \q na kuwahukumu watu wa ulimwengu kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe.
sw.R: Wataimba mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu anakuja. Anakuja kuitawala nchi kama mwamuzi. \q Atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki \q na kuwatendea watu wote kwa uaminifu.

es.L: delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque viene, porque viene a juzgar la tierra. \q Juzgará al mundo con justicia \q y a los pueblos con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fidelidad.
es.B: en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya está en camino, en camino para juzgar la tierra. \q Traerá justicia al mundo \q y juzgará a sus pueblos según {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia fidelidad.
es.R: Cantarán en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene. Viene a gobernar la tierra como juez. \q Juzgará al mundo con justicia \q y tratará a todos los pueblos con fidelidad.

vi.L: trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến để xét xử trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ xét xử thế gian bằng sự công chính \q và các dân bằng sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến, đang đến để xét xử trái đất. \q Ngài sẽ đem công lý đến cho thế gian \q và xét xử các dân theo sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ hát trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến. Ngài đang đến để cai trị trái đất như một vị thẩm phán. \q Ngài sẽ xét xử thế giới cách công bằng \q và đối xử với mọi dân tộc cách thành tín.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 [그리할 것이다]. 그분께서 오시기 때문이다. 그분께서 땅을 심판하러 오시기 때문이다. \q 그분께서 의로 세상을 심판하시고, \q 그분의 신실하심으로 백성들을 [심판하실 것이다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그리할 것이다. 그분께서 오고 계시기 때문이다. 땅을 심판하러 오고 계시기 때문이다. \q 그분께서 세상을 의롭게 재판하시고, \q 그분의 신실하심으로 백성들을 심판하실 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 노래할 것이다. 그분께서 오시기 때문이다. 그분께서 재판관으로서 땅을 다스리러 오신다. \q 그분께서 세상을 공정하게 심판하실 것이다. \q 모든 백성을 신실하게 대하실 것이다.

pt.L: diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem para julgar a terra. \q Ele julgará o mundo com justiça \q e os povos com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} fidelidade.
pt.B: na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está a caminho, a caminho para julgar a terra. \q Ele trará justiça ao mundo \q e julgará os povos da terra pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria fidelidade.
pt.R: Elas vão cantar na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está vindo. Ele está vindo para governar a terra como juiz. \q Ele vai julgar o mundo com justiça \q e tratar todos os povos com fidelidade.

am.L: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት፤ ይመጣልና፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና። \q በዓለም ላይ በጽድቅ፣ \q በወገኖችም ላይ በታማኝነቱ ይፈርዳል።
am.B: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት፤ በመምጣት ላይ ነውና፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ በመምጣት ላይ ነውና። \q ለዓለም ፍትሕን ያመጣል፤ \q ሕዝቦቿንም በገዛ ታማኝነቱ ይዳኛል።
am.R: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ይዘምራሉ፤ ምክንያቱም ይመጣል። ምድርን እንደ ዳኛ ሊገዛ ይመጣል። \q በዓለም ላይ በፍትሕ ይፈርዳል፤ \q ሕዝቦችንም ሁሉ በታማኝነት ይይዛል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने, क्योंकि वे आते हैं, क्योंकि वे पृथ्वी का न्याय करने आते हैं। \q वे धार्मिकता से जगत का न्याय करेंगे \q और अपनी सच्चाई से देश-देश के लोगों का।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की उपस्थिति में, क्योंकि वे आ रहे हैं, पृथ्वी का न्याय करने आ रहे हैं। \q वे जगत में न्याय स्थापित करेंगे \q और अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता से उसके लोगों का न्याय करेंगे।
hi.R: पेड़ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की उपस्थिति में गाएँगे, क्योंकि परमेश्वर आ रहे हैं। वे न्यायी के रूप में पृथ्वी पर राज्य करने आ रहे हैं। \q वे जगत का सच्चा न्याय करेंगे \q और सब लोगों के साथ विश्वासयोग्यता से व्यवहार करेंगे।

ru.L: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт судить землю. \q Он будет судить вселенную по праведности \q и племена — по своей верности.
ru.B: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} уже в пути, в пути, чтобы судить землю. \q Он установит справедливость в мире \q и будет судить его племена по своей верности.
