ru.R: Они запоют перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт. Он идёт править землёй как судья. \q Он будет судить мир справедливо \q и поступать со всеми народами по своей верности.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で。その方が来られるからである。地を裁くために来られるからである。 \q その方は、義をもって世界を裁き、 \q その真実をもって、もろもろの民をお裁きになる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の御前で。その方が来られるからだ。地を裁くために来られるからだ。 \q その方は、義をもって世界を裁き、 \q ご自分の真実によって、もろもろの民をお裁きになる。
ja.R: 彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で歌う。その方が来られるからだ。地を正しく治める裁き主として来られるのだ。 \q その方は、正しさをもって世界を裁き、 \q すべての民に、真実をもって接してくださる。

uk.L: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде судити землю. \q Він судитиме світ у праведності \q і народи — у своїй вірності.
uk.B: перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уже в дорозі, у дорозі, щоб судити землю. \q Він принесе світові правосуддя \q і судитиме його народи своєю власною вірністю.
uk.R: Вони співатимуть перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде. Він іде правити землею як суддя. \q Він судитиме світ справедливо \q і ставитиметься до всіх народів вірно.

decisions.choice: judge: rule and set things right
decisions.reason: The verb (shafat) means more than passing sentence: it is to govern and to put wrongs right. For a world under wrong, the coming of this Judge is good news, and creation sings.

decisions.choice: for he comes, for he comes: repeated for emphasis
decisions.reason: The repetition makes the arrival urgent and near. The form can mean "he has come" or "he is coming"; the joy of verses 11-12 looks forward to it.

decisions.choice: Psalm 98:9; 1 Chronicles 16:33
decisions.reason: Psalm 98:9 ends with almost the same words; the parallel in 1 Chronicles 16:33 stops after "to judge the earth".

decisions.choice: They will sing
decisions.reason: Readable ended verse 12 with a full stop, so it repeats the subject: the trees sing before the LORD.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그리할 것이다", with the verb of verse 12 restated
alternatives: "before the LORD" joined to the end of verse 12
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "before the LORD" belongs to the shout of the trees in verse 12. Korean cannot carry a phrase across a full stop after its verb, so it restates the verb here (bracketed at Literal), as the English Readable does with "They will sing".

decisions.choice: the repeated "for he comes" and the last two lines follow the psalm's Hebrew; the shared words ("{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት", "በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና") as 1 Chronicles 16:33
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "for he comes to judge the earth" once and ends there; the psalm repeats the phrase and adds the judging of the world and the peoples (as Psalm 98:9).

decisions.choice: the repeated "for he comes"; the last two lines
decisions.reason: The psalm says "for he comes" twice (meaning m2) where 1 Chronicles 16:33 says it once, and adds the last two lines, which Psalm 98:9 repeats (meaning m3). The rest keeps the Hindi of Chronicles. God's faithfulness is "सच्चाई" (L) and "विश्वासयोग्यता" (B, R), as the poetry note has it. Readable names the trees and then God ("परमेश्वर आ रहे हैं") so that "वे" is not taken for the trees.

decisions.choice: the first line as 1 Chronicles 16:33, with "he comes" twice
decisions.reason: The psalm repeats "for he comes" (m2) and adds two lines that Chronicles does not have; the shared words keep the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:33.

decisions.choice: First line as 1CH 16:33b with the psalm's repeated ki va' ("その方が来られるからである。地を裁くために来られるからである"); the last two lines new; tsedeq "義" (L, B), "正しさ" (R); 'emunah "真実"
decisions.reason: The psalm repeats 'for he comes' (m2) and adds two lines on judging; Psalm 98:9 has nearly the same words (m3), and its Japanese should match. R supplies 'They will sing' as the English R.

decisions.choice: lishpot "裁く" (L, B), "正しく治める裁き主" (R); "お裁きになる" for the last verb
decisions.reason: To judge is to rule and set things right (m1); in a chain of verbs the last carries the respect form, and お裁きになる avoids the passive reading of 裁かれる.
